name: Alice Weidel
role: AfD co-leader (since 2022), leader of the AfD Bundestag group, 2025 chancellor candidate
summary: Weidel is a free-market, nationalist-conservative politician who led the AfD's 2025 programme: sharp cuts to taxes, subsidies and welfare, an end to the energy transition with a return to nuclear and coal and Russian gas, closed borders and strict citizenship rules, and sovereignty-first positions on the EU, with Swiss-style referendums. She lives in a registered same-sex partnership and backs equal legal status for it while defending the traditional family model.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: No recorded position found: the only evidence is an older secondhand report, with no statement of her own.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: In the July 2025 budget debate she said Germany's postwar recovery came from Ludwig Erhard's market-based order, not Keynes's interventionism, and in November 2025 she asked for market-economy order instead of planning and a deregulation programme releasing market forces.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: In July 2026 she called the coalition's 'Reichensteuer' a mere envy tax that takes money from the Mittelstand; her programme abolishes the suspended wealth tax and her party's Bundestag line is to cut taxes across the board.

property-fundamental.rationale: She repeatedly frames the heating law, a wealth register and inheritance-tax plans as expropriation of homeowners and savers ('kalte Enteignung'); the programme calls cash protection against expropriation.

regulate-corporations.rationale: She demands abolition of the supply-chain laws on national and EU level and a deregulation programme freeing business from bureaucratic rules; no call for tighter corporate regulation was found.

cut-welfare.rationale: She wants the Buergergeld abolished and replaced by an activating basic income that 'drastically' cuts costs, while keeping support for the truly needy and pensions; she did not use the dependency argument as such.

surveillance-ok.rationale: The programme rejects the trend toward a surveillance state, rejects wide video surveillance, state trojans and data retention, and she attacks EU chat control as spying on citizens.

legalize-drugs.rationale: The programme calls the cannabis release a mistake to be corrected and backs abstinence-oriented addiction care; no wider drug policy view from her was found.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: She calls the campaign against 'hate and incitement' an attack on free speech, and the programme says any censorship violates freedom of expression.

state-harmful.rationale: She says the state must focus on core tasks (security, rule of law, public order) and elsewhere names infrastructure, education and support for the needy as state tasks.

limit-guns.rationale: The programme says the 2024 weapons-law changes put legal owners under general suspicion and that action should target illegal weapons.

empower-police-military.rationale: The programme strengthens police and border police and wants the Bundeswehr well funded; she attacks debt-financed arms spending as ill-judged, so support is for capability rather than size of budgets.

rehabilitation.rationale: The programme lowers criminal responsibility to age 12, requires minimum time served before parole and detains repeat offenders quickly; it does not centre rehabilitation.

traditional-family.rationale: She called the family of father, mother and children a guiding model she herself represents, while stressing 'family is where children are'.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: In February 2025 she said registered partnerships should be legally equal to marriage, including tax, but 'without touching the institution of marriage', so she backs equal rights and opposes extending the marriage label.

abortion-legal.rationale: The programme calls the existing sections 218 ff of the criminal code balanced and in need of only stricter implementation, opposes advertising by doctors and any 'human right' to abortion; no personal statement from her was found.

gender-social-construct.rationale: The programme states that the two sexes are a biological fact, rejects the self-determination law and wants gender research funding ended; she has also derided 'gender idiocy'.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: She stresses preservation of German identity against mass naturalisation and 'incompatible cultures', and the programme she led makes a German Leitkultur central.

reduce-immigration.rationale: She wants illegal immigration cut to zero, family reunification stopped, deportations and the individual right to asylum abolished, and called for ending mass migration and reversing it; her group votes on this line and the programme she led is built on it.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: She called the UN incapable of acting and backs Trump's Peace Board as an alternative; the programme seeks UN reform and rejects UN compacts and a WHO pandemic treaty giving directive powers.

free-trade.rationale: The programme wants trade barriers removed, favourable trade agreements and sanctions ended, but also abolishes the CO2 border adjustment.

nation-first.rationale: She says Germany must define and assert its national interests even against allies, calls for cutting aid and EU payments to spend at home, and her motion line is 'for one's own people'.

open-borders.rationale: She demands full border controls with turn-backs and a 'policy of the closed door', and calls open borders the dogma that is ruining the country.

limit-growth.rationale: She blames climate policy for deindustrialisation and demands a deregulation programme to release growth.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: She called climate protection a dogma, demanded ending the energy transition and all climate measures, and her group moved to abolish CO2 pricing and end all climate measures.

expand-nuclear.rationale: She calls for re-entry into nuclear power in nearly every Bundestag speech, called the phase-out a fatal error and her group moved for a moratorium on dismantling shut-down plants.

experts-over-public.rationale: She attacked a court candidate's wish for a government of unelected experts, and the programme trusts citizens' decisions over professional politicians.

central-planning.rationale: She repeatedly describes the energy transition and climate policy as 'eco-socialist planned economy' and demands market-economy order instead, in budget debates in 2025 and in her twelve-point plan.

tax-inheritance.rationale: She called a planned tougher inheritance tax confiscatory and hostile to the Mittelstand, the programme abolishes it, and she voted in October 2026 to keep the special rule for very large inheritances.

basic-income.rationale: She criticises the Buergergeld as having become an unconditional basic income with runaway costs and calls for an activating basic income with work requirements.

state-directs-investment.rationale: She wants clientele subsidies cut, renewable subsidies ended and criticises a state-steered, state-financed arms industry replacing real industry; the programme limits state intervention in markets to a minimum.

widespread-small-property.rationale: The programme sets the goal of making Germany 'a people of owners' through help for tenants to buy homes; it does not address concentration in corporations as such.

one-party-rule.rationale: She defends opposition and pluralism and says banning competing parties begins every dictatorship.

direct-votes.rationale: The programme demands Swiss-style referendums that can change or reject laws passed by parliament, and she backed a referendum on leaving the EU, saying the people should decide.

political-violence-never.rationale: She condemned the murder of Charlie Kirk and left-wing arson and sabotage as political violence and demanded clear condemnation, but never stated that political violence is never justified.

private-courts-defense.rationale: She says the state's core tasks are internal and external security and rule of law.

ethnic-nation.rationale: She said an ethnic concept of the people is not unconstitutional because the Basic Law itself rests on it, and wants mass immigration reversed; she does not claim every state must be mono-ethnic.

equal-outcomes.rationale: She argues that performance should pay and attacks the 'envy tax', redistribution and a 'performance-hostile' SPD.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: She frames industrial decline and deindustrialisation as the catastrophe, defending the car, steel and chemical industries.

taxation-theft.rationale: She calls the overall burden (46 cents left of an earned euro) robbery, yet says the state should manage on tax revenue for core tasks, so she does not reject taxation as such.

conscription.rationale: On ARD and ZDF in February 2025 she backed a two-year Wehrpflicht, the programme restores conscription, and her September 2025 speech says conscription exists to ensure national defence capability.

total-state.rationale: She says the state must keep out of the economy and the private lives of citizens.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: She said Israel's right to exist is beyond discussion and that Israel has a legitimate right to security; she told Musk she supports Israel.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: She called the March 2025 debt-brake reform a financial coup, said debt does not create growth and wants spending to fit tax revenue; her group's alternative budget aimed to avoid new debt.

economic-freedom.rationale: She presents the AfD as defending freedom and rule of law against bureaucracy and repression, but did not state the link between political and economic freedom as such.

national-self-determination.rationale: She asks EU states that want to keep sovereignty to leave the EU migrant distribution scheme and says the people should decide on EU membership.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: She wants full social benefits only for members of the contributing solidarity community, benefits tied to a minimum contribution period, in-kind aid for asylum seekers and no Buergergeld for Ukrainians; this is contribution-based rather than strictly citizenship-based.

work-for-welfare.rationale: She wants the Buergergeld replaced by an 'aktivierende Grundsicherung' and the programme demands sanctions when reasonable work is refused and makes unemployment support less attractive than work.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: The programme speaks of women and men complementing each other but demands equal rights in all areas; no call for different legal roles was found.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: The programme rules out the lignite phase-out and plans new coal capacity, and she calls for re-entry into coal power and gas; domestic oil and gas extraction was not addressed.

elite-replacement.rationale: In 2018 she spoke of a strategy of 'generational replacement' through unregulated immigration; recent speeches blame policy and 'politics against one's own people' without describing deliberate replacement.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: She repeatedly accuses the governing class of lobby ties, 'Parteibuchwirtschaft', an NGO swamp and a 'corrupt' EU superstructure while ignoring ordinary citizens.

night-watchman-state.rationale: She said the state should confine itself to core tasks of internal and external security, rule of law and public order, but elsewhere endorses infrastructure, education and aid for the needy, so the evidence is mixed.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: The programme requires marriage contracts to follow German law only and annuls polygamous and forced marriages under Muslim practice, applying one legal order to all.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: She said a ban on competing parties starts every dictatorship, while the programme calls for a militant democracy that defends itself against right, left and Islamist extremism and bans violent left-wing groups.

separated-powers.rationale: She accuses the government of damaging the separation of powers (court appointments) and the programme calls for strict separation of government and parliament.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: She links mass immigration to imported conflicts, 'incompatible cultures', religious conflict and crime and the programme calls for a German Leitkultur for cohesion.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: She criticised restrictions of basic rights during the Corona period and the programme criticises curtailing fundamental rights in the name of security.

party-controls-media.rationale: She calls attempts to silence critics repression and defends freedom of expression; the programme says every censorship is an attack on that right.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: She repeatedly demands naturalisation at the earliest after ten years (September and November 2025), in the programme and in her twelve-point plan.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: The programme strengthens the free mandate of members of parliament against party and group.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: She backed a 'Dexit' referendum if the EU cannot be reformed, calls the EU part of the problem and demands the EU's powers cut back and payments to Brussels limited.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: The programme wants chancellor terms limited; unlimited re-election of presidents was not addressed.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: The programme keeps NATO membership central until an independent European military alliance exists.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: The programme rejects early sexualisation and gender ideology in schools; she has said she does not want 'early sexualisation classes' near her children.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: The programme returns to the law as before 1990: citizenship by birth to at least one German parent and discretionary naturalisation, and she calls for ending entitlement naturalisation.

minority-language-support.rationale: The programme keeps recognised minority languages equal in status; support in schools and elections was not addressed.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: She demands drastic cuts to development aid and global climate payments, calls the aid wasteful and her group's alternative budget cuts it.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: The programme demands that the Federal President be elected directly by the people.

collective-defense.rationale: The programme names national and alliance defence as the Bundeswehr's core mission and keeps NATO membership as a central element until a European alliance exists.

flat-income-tax.rationale: She calls for an income tax with 'uniformly low rates' and high allowances (Steuerreform 25), while the programme describes a tariff with a few steps rather than a single rate, so the evidence is mixed.

women-must-cover.rationale: She and the programme want to ban the burka and niqab in public and to ban headscarves in public institutions; a legal duty to cover is the opposite of her stated position.

common-currency.rationale: Her programme demands leaving the euro system and she called the euro a failure, but in 2026 she said it is a myth that the AfD wants to leave the euro, so the recent position is unclear.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: The programme rejects quotas by sex for voters and public offices and wants equality officers abolished; filling posts on qualification alone.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: The programme speaks of animals as sentient fellow creatures and animal welfare in farming.

animal-use-humane.rationale: The programme affirms animal husbandry in Germany with species-appropriate housing, shorter transport and stunning before ritual slaughter.

office-by-exam.rationale: The programme demands offices be filled by suitability, ability and performance and an end to party-book patronage.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: The programme wants relations with China developed only with protection from sell-off of German technologies, companies and key industries; this concerns China only.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: She says her pension concept is not privatisation: the statutory pension stays, supplemented by state-supported capital-funded pillars and a compensation fund.

single-official-language.rationale: The programme asks to write German into the constitution as state language but keeps recognised minority languages equal, so it does not restrict others.

corporate-influence.rationale: The programme wants lobbying controlled and says beneficiaries of climate policy are international concerns with lobbies; she accuses ties to BlackRock-type investors.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: The programme wants foreign NGOs to disclose financing and bans foreign state funding of mosques and organisations; she wants public funding of party-near NGOs banned.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: The programme offers family splitting, financial aid for parents and a welcome culture for children aimed at raising the birth rate, and she links the pension problem to a low birth rate; her group moved to convert spouse splitting into family support.

residents-only-property.rationale: The programme says locals should be preferred when building plots and housing are allocated under the local-resident model; it does not describe outright purchase limits.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: The programme and she invoke the constitutional protection of marriage and family and want spouse splitting turned into family splitting rather than dropping marriage rights.

public-access-to-information.rationale: She criticised the coalition for tightening the freedom of information law so that citizens and journalists ask fewer uncomfortable questions.

national-law-over-international.rationale: The programme rejects binding supranational rules, wants UN migration compacts cancelled and the ECHR and refugee convention reformed, and puts internal security above EU asylum rules.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: She lives in a registered partnership with a woman and demands that such partnerships be legally equal to marriage; a call to criminalise same-sex relations is incompatible with this.

suppress-opposition.rationale: She argues that banning competing parties begins every dictatorship and calls the idea of banning the AfD anti-democratic.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: The programme wants the self-determination law of 2024 fully repealed and bans puberty blockers and non-indicated gender transition measures.

assisted-dying.rationale: The programme rejects a legal entitlement to assisted dying, wants killing on request to stay banned and warns of pressure on the seriously ill.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: The programme demands a headscarf ban in public institutions, especially schools, and she has called for banning the headscarf from public spaces.

social-market-economy.rationale: The programme states firm commitment to the principles of the social market economy with competition first, and she cites Erhard's order and support for the truly needy.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: She wants a capable Bundeswehr, conscription and the army able to defend the country.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: The programme keeps NATO membership and wants Ukraine neutral outside NATO and the EU.

term-limits.rationale: The programme limits the chancellor to three terms and MPs to four legislative periods.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: The programme demands equal rights of men and women in all areas, including for Muslim women, but does not address marital authority directly.

rent-control.rationale: The programme rejects the rent brake and rent cap as state over-regulation hindering investment.

sex-socially-constructed.rationale: The programme declares the two sexes a biological fact and wants the self-determination law and puberty blockers for transition banned.

anonymous-payments.rationale: She argues that abolition of cash and a digital euro would give the state total control over money flows, and the programme calls cash protection from total surveillance.

gm-crops.rationale: The programme supports new genomic techniques such as CRISPR and technology openness but wants strict monitoring of use in farming.

pollution-taxes.rationale: She calls CO2 pricing a tax on air, demands its complete abolition, her group moved to abolish it, and she voted against the CO2 price amendment in October 2026.

capital-controls.rationale: She described EU efforts to stop people moving their money and capital abroad, together with cash abolition, as the next stage of repression.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: She denounced the circumvention of the debt brake as unconstitutional breach, demanded that the public sector live within tax revenue and called the 2027 budget unconstitutional for its borrowing.

public-service-media.rationale: She says the GEZ fees will be abolished; the programme keeps a fee-free basic service and demands a slimmed, de-ideologised public broadcaster.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: She demands ending the 'policy of bans and tutelage', the combustion engine ban and the heating law.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: The programme makes language ability a condition for selection, naturalisation and imams and mandates German lessons for children who lack it; she criticises children who cannot speak German.

women-suffrage.rationale: The programme demands equal rights for men and women in all areas; she herself holds office as a party leader and chancellor candidate.

gender-equality-agencies.rationale: The programme abolishes equality officers; in 2025 she called the queer commissioner post superfluous and attacked the 'Beauftragtenunwesen'.

indirect-election.rationale: The programme prefers direct election of the head of state and referendums over indirect selection.

close-ties-china.rationale: The programme wants to expand economic, scientific and cultural contacts with China under fairness conditions, but rejects Chinese firms in digital infrastructure.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: She calls for abolishing the CO2 levy and electricity tax and sharply cutting fuel and energy taxes; her group moved to cut electricity tax and the programme lowers VAT for restaurants to 7%.

no-business-privileges.rationale: She demands an end to clientele subsidies and subsidies for wind and solar power; she did not address legal privileges specifically.

multipolar-world.rationale: The programme notes a shift to a multipolar order and wants an interest-led relation to the US, China and Russia, without framing multipolarity as a goal.

patriotism-serves-workers.rationale: She says the AfD, not the SPD, is now the party of workers and that it makes politics 'for one's own people'.

notes: Her evidence is dominated by Bundestag speeches from May 2025 to October 2026 and the 2025 programme she led. Programme-only answers are medium or lower because a party programme is not her own record. Positions on the euro, same-sex marriage and the minimum wage rest on mixed or older reports and are low confidence. Weidel's January 2025 X conversation with Elon Musk was only available through press reports, so it is used for a few items only. Positions that changed: on the euro she moved from calling for exit (2015, programme 2025) to calling it a myth in 2026 that the AfD wants out.
